newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hwan Yung Steel seeks court receivership.
newsitem.headline: Hwan Yung Steel seeks court receivership.

text.p: South Korea's Hwan Yung Steel Industry Co said in a statement on Saturday it had applied for court receivership due to worsening internal financial position.
The statement said the application had been filed with a court in the city of Pusan, where the company is located.
Hwan Yung, which mainly produces steel bars, said its financial position has worsened due to the sluggish economy and low demand.
The statement gave no further details and company officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
